case:
PRIOR AUTHORIZATION REQUEST
Ref: PA/2026/51203
Date: 22 August 2026

PATIENT
Name: [redacted]        Age: 36 years        Sex: Female
Obstetric history: Para 1, one living child. Desires no further children.

PRESENTING COMPLAINT
Heavy menstrual bleeding for the past 14 months. Soaking 6-8 pads per day
during menses, passing clots. Cycles every 24-26 days, lasting 8 days.
Reports fatigue and breathlessness on climbing stairs.

EXAMINATION
Pallor present. Abdomen soft, uterus palpable per abdomen, approximately
16 weeks size, firm, irregular surface, mobile, non-tender.

INVESTIGATIONS DONE
Pelvic ultrasound (14 Aug 2026): Bulky uterus 15.8 x 9.2 cm. Multiple
intramural fibroids, largest 7.4 cm in the posterior wall. Endometrial
thickness 9 mm. Both ovaries normal. No adnexal mass.
Haemoglobin: 8.1 g/dL.

PRIOR TREATMENT
Tranexamic acid 500 mg TDS during menses for 5 cycles - partial response.
Norethisterone 5 mg BD for 4 cycles - no sustained improvement, bleeding
recurred on stopping.

REQUESTED SERVICE
Total abdominal hysterectomy with bilateral salpingectomy, ovaries to be
conserved. Inpatient, district hospital.

DOCUMENTS ATTACHED
Ultrasound report, haemogram, treatment record for medical management.
